description: He wears a burgundy long noble tunic and matching open surcoat-like robe with broad muted gold floral and geometric woven borders at the edges, sleeve openings and hem. The maroon cloth has a subtle patterned brocade-like surface, while cream full sleeves and a fine cream standing collar show underneath. A brown leather-looking belt carries gold-toned fittings and a long ornamented strap. Dark fitted legwear and tall brown boots complete the opaque outfit. No crown, armor, weapon or headgear is visible. Textile fibers are uncertain; the surfaces appear substantial and richly woven.
